name: be-framework/demo-hello-world
description: Be Framework Hello World Demo - The simplest transformation

scripts-descriptions.dev: Run the Hello World demo in dev mode; writes a semantic log to var/log/*.json without Xdebug/XHProf profiling.
scripts-descriptions.profile: Run the Hello World demo with semantic profiling; writes a semantic log to var/log/*.json with uncompressed Xdebug trace and xhprof enabled.
scripts-descriptions.stree: Render the latest var/log/*.json as a compact tree.
scripts-descriptions.stree:full: Render the latest var/log/*.json as a semantic full tree with full props and close.profile details.
